en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a city square with a large ornate fountain in the foreground, several pigeons, a man in uniform or work clothes, and prominent historical architecture including a large cathedral with a rose window and distinctive Romanesque elements. The building to the left has battlements, suggesting a palatial or government function. Text at the top reads 'Trento, Piazza del Duomo.'
